labeling.method: one human pass over the full YouTube auto-caption transcript (cues collapsed to ~10s lines); two speakers (Neal Brennan host, Russell Peters guest) seated at a desk; no end credits (outro ~57:40); timing from caption cues, ~+-5s

moments.note: How they met in 1997: hanging out in Dave's hotel room, the dog barking, Esther Rolle (Mrs. Evans from Good Times) knocks: 'will you keep it down'
'I've only been married twice' ... 'how's that going?' 'We're getting divorced now'
Divorce isn't his fault 'for the first time in my life'; 'eight billion people you can mess with - don't mess with these two' (his kids)
Warned her early; 'wrong and strong' is never the answer
'55. She's 53' - Neal: 'talk about an unforced error at 53'
Quote he saw: women sleep with who they want, men with who they can; marry the other way round; 'you're the prize'
Neal: women don't like me for money, I'm a pain; 'if you trust any compliment a woman gives about your d***, you're a fool'
Rock bottom: pandemic accountant made him sell the Hidden Hills house for 7.8M - worth 15 now
Spending a fortune a month, 'I'm going to bleep these numbers'; health insurance for his friends - 'Canadians don't need it'
'Financially illiterate'; Neal mentioned an index fund and Russell had never heard of it
Accountant filed his taxes two years and never paid them: 'how do you whoopsy-daisy it two years in a row?'
Used to buy a 100-grand watch on sight, now 'five grand? are you crazy'; sold the Rolls, the Lambo, the watches
'He left me in an 8 million dollar hole' - 'Well, well, well'
Neal's issue with Malibu: too cold, 'it's not a real beach' - Hawaii is
Tour name 'Relax': a guy at Costco told his upset wife 'relax, it's not that serious'
Biggest waste of money: private jets - 'a great way to burn 30 grand' to be home eight hours early
Billionaire friends don't own planes: 'if they think it's a waste of money, it's definitely a waste of money'
Hollywood is fickle - in favour, out of favour; people used him to expand internationally then dropped him
His fan base is so loyal 'I'm a fool to chase anything else'; arenas from 2007 to 2025; 'I want what I have'
'This business is full of phonies' - tells them to their face: 'what are you going to do, fight me? I'll knock you out'
Retells Gillie's Roc Nation brunch rant: 'nothing but Jay-Z putting a bunch of people on the lawn'
Comics he took on the road and paid well never reach back; won't send his niece a 5-second video; 'you follow me and mute me'
'I'm not bitter, I'm awakened'; 'the last thing this industry wants is somebody that's real'
Neal: the fake industry is ending - TV shows will end, it's all going to be podcasts and YouTube
The first YouTube comic: the 'Indians can't live without a bargain, Chinese can't give you a bargain' bit went viral
Meeting billionaires changed him: they gave him real game, and 'billionaires don't really flex'
Never flossed on Instagram - 'you're trying to get robbed'; 'I got killers at the house'
Ex-con friends who did 30 years chilling in his jacuzzi - 'a summer camp for ex-cons'
Inferiority complex since age 3-4: racism in 70s/80s Toronto, a grown man sprayed him with a hose; hung around the Black kids
Everyone has a default setting - anger, misery, sadness; 'mine has always been happiness'
'I'm waiting for somebody else to validate me... why can't I just validate myself?'
Private gig for the 7th richest man: 'I knew I was inferior - that's not a complex, that's a reality'; demanded Emirates first class via Dubai
Boxing lesson: don't say 'ow' - 'if nobody knows what bothers you, they can't bother you'
'Never let your ego dictate your moves'
Neal: 'you had a lifetime supply of heroin' (arenas) and still chased late-night TV; 'what's a late night talk show?'
Daughter: 'I'm never gonna have daddy issues... I might have mommy issues'
Kids get too much information; find the person they will listen to and have them talk to them
Never raised his voice at his daughter in 14 years; his son's eyes fill up - careful how he navigates it
'I don't know how my dad didn't beat the s*** out of me' - he was a mouthy kid
Past the stage of goals: just live life, be in the moment, enjoy it
